description: YHPrimCoat-1010 is a single-component, low-VOC, water-based, versatile acrylic primer that enhances the performance and adhesion of coating and mortar products on substrates. It is suitable for a wide variety of substrates for external and internal floors and walls to help improve the chemical resistance, corrosion resistance, moisture resistance and salt resistance.
whereToUse: It is suitable for use as a primer of water-based waterproofing or flooring works on various substrates, such as concrete, cement, brickwork,etc.
external and internal floors and walls
advantages: Versatile primer for a wide variety of substrate conditions.
notFor: Substrate and ambient temperatures must be between (5~35)℃.
Do not apply on wet substrates.
The substrate must be clean, dry, sound and free of rust, paint, grease, oil and laitance.
For porous substrate it may need more coats or apply a layer of mortar to seal the substrate and prevent substrate outgassing.

technicalData.label: Application
technicalData.value: Apply the primer to the absorbent surface with a nap roller.

technicalData.label: Maximum wait time
technicalData.value: The maximum wait time from initial application is 24 h.

consumption.quote: Normally apply one coat at a rate of approximately 0.1-0.2kg/m2/coat.

storage: Under normal storage and transportation conditions, the shelf life is 12 months.
